lines.zh: 我踩着落花走，蹄边全是黄花瓣。
lines.en: I walk on fallen petals, buttercup yellow at every hoof.

lines.zh: 花丛太密，我一边走一边拨开。
lines.en: The flowers grow thick; I push them aside as I walk.

lines.zh: 背上的毛茛晃得厉害，我走得很慢。
lines.en: The buttercups on my back sway hard, so I walk slowly.

lines.zh: 我绕着蜂巢走，怕惊了那群蜜蜂。
lines.en: I veer around the bee nest so I do not startle them.

lines.zh: 阳光照在背上，我的花都朝上抬。
lines.en: Sunlight hits my back and every bloom lifts upward.

lines.zh: 别踩那丛毛茛，我正要过去吃。
lines.en: Mind that buttercup patch; I am on my way to eat it.

lines.zh: 我走一步，背上就掉下一片花瓣。
lines.en: With each step a petal drops from my back.

lines.zh: 繁花森林的路我熟，闭眼也不会撞树。
lines.en: I know the flower forest; I could walk it blind.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过草丛，惊起几只蜜蜂。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass and startles a few bees.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是因为背上这身花太重。
lines.en: I walk slowly because this coat of flowers is heavy.

lines.zh: 我顺着花香走，越走越靠近林子深处。
lines.en: I follow the scent of blossoms deeper into the woods.

lines.zh: 蹄子沾了泥，我停下来蹭干净才走。
lines.en: My hooves are muddy; I stop to wipe them before going on.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，嚼到一朵花就停一下。
lines.en: I chew the grass and pause whenever I reach a flower.

lines.zh: 我的叫声低得像木桶滚动。
lines.en: My moo rolls low, like a barrel being dragged.

lines.zh: 数一数我背上的花，今天又多了两朵。
lines.en: Count the blooms on my back; two more opened today.

lines.zh: 蜂在我耳边绕，我懒得赶它。
lines.en: A bee circles my ear and I cannot be bothered to shoo it.

lines.zh: 我低头闻自己的影子，闻到黄油味。
lines.en: I sniff my own shadow and smell butter.

lines.zh: 雨落在花上，我一动不动地淋着。
lines.en: Rain falls on my flowers and I stand still in it.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴打掉背上的枯瓣。
lines.en: I flick dead petals off my back with my tail.

lines.zh: 有人拿碗靠近，我就知道要盛汤了。
lines.en: When a bowl comes near, I know stew is being made.

lines.zh: 我反刍的时候，花也跟着一上一下。
lines.en: As I chew my cud, the flowers rise and fall with me.

lines.zh: 这片林子开得真好，我哪也不想去。
lines.en: The forest is blooming so well I want to go nowhere.

lines.zh: 我打个响鼻，把鼻尖的花粉吹散。
lines.en: I snort and blow the pollen off my nose.

lines.zh: 我的花今天有点蔫，我在等太阳。
lines.en: My blooms are wilting a little; I am waiting for sun.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂把我看成一朵大花，落在我背上。
lines.en: A bee takes me for one big flower and lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，把一整个下午眨过去。
lines.en: I blink slowly and blink the whole afternoon away.

lines.zh: 我把鼻尖埋进花丛里。
lines.en: I bury my nose in the flowers.

lines.zh: 我背上的花跟着风一起歪。
lines.en: The flowers on my back lean with the wind.

lines.zh: 我等蜜蜂走了再动。
lines.en: I wait for the bee to leave before moving.

lines.zh: 我嚼到一棵甜草，停了一下。
lines.en: I hit a sweet stalk of grass and pause.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剪刀，先收起来好吗。
lines.en: Would you put those shears away first, please?

lines.zh: 你站得离我的花太近了。
lines.en: You are standing far too close to my flowers.

lines.zh: 你身上有草味，你也是吃草的？
lines.en: You smell of grass; do you eat it too?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，背上的花跟着抖。
lines.en: I look up at you and the flowers on my back shake.

lines.zh: 你拿着碗，是想喝我的汤吗？
lines.en: You are holding a bowl; do you want my stew?

lines.zh: 别摸角，那里还沾着花瓣。
lines.en: Not the horns; there are petals stuck there.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我背上的花很好笑吗？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Are my flowers funny?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有没有剪刀。
lines.en: I watch your hands, checking for shears.

lines.zh: 你要剪就直说，别从背后过来。
lines.en: If you mean to shear me, say so; do not come from behind.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有毛茛的花粉。
lines.en: There is buttercup pollen on your boots.

lines.zh: 我认得你，上次你给我喂过草。
lines.en: I know you; you fed me grass last time.

lines.zh: 你走慢点，我背着花追不上。
lines.en: Slow down; I cannot keep up carrying these blooms.

lines.zh: 疼得我一抖，花瓣掉了一地。
lines.en: The pain makes me shudder and petals fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 你碰到了花下面那块皮。
lines.en: You hit the skin beneath the flowers.

lines.zh: 我哞了一声，声音都劈了。
lines.en: I moo and the sound cracks in half.

lines.zh: 这伤口藏在花里，你都没看见。
lines.en: The wound is hidden under the blooms; you never saw it.

lines.zh: 我的角歪了，得慢慢正回来。
lines.en: My horn is knocked crooked; I must ease it back.

lines.zh: 花被血黏住了，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Blood glues the petals down and I cannot shake them off.

lines.zh: 我退到花丛深处，压坏一片。
lines.en: I back deep into the flowers and crush a patch.

lines.zh: 疼得我前腿一软，跪了下去。
lines.en: The pain buckles my front legs and I go down.

lines.zh: 我的毛茛全蔫了。
lines.en: Every buttercup on me has wilted.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起剪刀的声音。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of the sound of shears.

lines.zh: 小麦！你把小麦举高一点。
lines.en: Wheat! Hold the wheat up a little higher.

lines.zh: 我不吃花，我身上已经够多了。
lines.en: I do not eat flowers; I am already covered in them.

lines.zh: 那束草闻起来甜甜的，给我。
lines.en: That bunch of grass smells sweet; give it here.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只为你手里的麦子。
lines.en: I follow you only for the wheat in your hand.

lines.zh: 你说这是繁花森林的草？我要尝。
lines.en: Flower forest grass, you say? I must taste it.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子伸过去，别抽走。
lines.en: I stretch my nose toward it; do not pull it away.

lines.zh: 为了这一口，我可以走很远。
lines.en: For this one mouthful I would walk a long way.

lines.zh: 麦粒掉在地上了，我低头去捡。
lines.en: A wheat grain fell; I lower my head to pick it up.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西比花还香。
lines.en: What you hold smells better than any flower.

lines.zh: 我小跑起来，花在背上乱晃。
lines.en: I break into a trot and the blooms sway wildly.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的花挡了你的路。
lines.en: Sorry, my flowers got in your way.

lines.zh: 我撞到你了？我不是故意的。
lines.en: Did I bump you? I did not mean to.

lines.zh: 别推我，花会被你碰掉。
lines.en: Do not shove me; you will knock the blooms off.

lines.zh: 我转身太慢，角先碰到了你。
lines.en: I turn too slowly and my horn hits you first.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得花瓣落了一地。
lines.en: That bump sends petals down all over the ground.

lines.zh: 你站我侧面吧，那边没有角。
lines.en: Stand on my side; there is no horn there.

lines.zh: 我的身子比看起来沉。
lines.en: I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 我们卡在花丛里了，一起退开。
lines.en: We are stuck in the flowers; let us both back out.

lines.zh: 你踩到蹄子边那圈花了。
lines.en: You stepped on the flowers ringing my hoof.

lines.zh: 别挤，我的花经不起碰。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; my flowers cannot take bumping.

lines.zh: 你背上的花比我多，我们换一换？
lines.en: You have more blooms than I do; shall we trade?

lines.zh: 两头牛的花蹭在一起，香得发晕。
lines.en: Two cows rub flowers together until the scent makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会是什么颜色？
lines.en: What color will our calf be?

lines.zh: 别站在中间，我们正忙着。
lines.en: Do not stand between us; we are busy.

lines.zh: 我的角碰你的角，轻轻的。
lines.en: My horn touches yours, very gently.

lines.zh: 花丛够大，我们并排吃草。
lines.en: The patch is big enough; we graze side by side.

lines.zh: 你也闻到了？那是我背上的花蜜。
lines.en: Do you smell it too? That is nectar on my back.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我的花会被压坏。
lines.en: Careful, my flowers will be crushed.

lines.zh: 等小牛出生，我教它认毛茛。
lines.en: When the calf comes, I will teach it buttercups.

lines.zh: 我在你身边打转，花也跟着转。
lines.en: I circle you and the flowers circle with me.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用鼻子拱。
lines.en: I have no hands; I can only nudge with my nose.

lines.zh: 这东西闻起来不像草。
lines.en: This thing does not smell like grass.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在角上带走。
lines.en: I carry it away balanced on my horn.

lines.zh: 你掉的麦子我帮你捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up the wheat you dropped.

lines.zh: 碗要放稳，别洒了汤。
lines.en: Set the bowl steady or the stew will spill.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的边，希望没咬坏。
lines.en: I take its edge in my teeth, hoping I did not bite through.

lines.zh: 它太滑，从我嘴边掉下去了。
lines.en: It is too slippery and slid out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我背上已经有花了，放不下别的。
lines.en: My back is full of flowers; nothing else fits.

lines.zh: 你捡吧，我只会把它再碰倒。
lines.en: You pick it up; I will only knock it over again.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起熟透的苹果。
lines.en: This smell reminds me of a ripe apple.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了那片毛茛，我看见了。
lines.en: You crushed that buttercup patch; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我的花少了一朵，是你剪的？
lines.en: One of my blooms is gone; did you shear it?

lines.zh: 别跑，先把剪刀放下。
lines.en: Do not run; put the shears down first.

lines.zh: 我低头，把角对准你。
lines.en: I lower my head and aim my horns at you.

lines.zh: 这片花田归我管。
lines.en: This flower field is under my care.

lines.zh: 你身上有剪刀的响声。
lines.en: I hear the click of shears on you.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，我背上的花瓣在你口袋里。
lines.en: I smell it: my petals are in your pocket.

lines.zh: 走开，别碰我的蜜蜂。
lines.en: Back off; leave my bees alone.

lines.zh: 我喘气变粗了，你最好退后。
lines.en: My breathing goes rough; you had better step back.

lines.zh: 我认准你了，别想绕过去。
lines.en: I have fixed on you; do not try to go around.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，一步也不放。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on your hands and will not look away.

lines.zh: 你退到花畦尽头，我还在。
lines.en: Back to the end of the bed; I am still here.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在土里刨出印子。
lines.en: My hooves carve marks into the dirt.

lines.zh: 花丛在挡我，我直接碾过去。
lines.en: The flowers are in my way; I will just trample through.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后也没用。
lines.en: Hiding behind a tree will not help you.

lines.zh: 角尖离你越来越近了。
lines.en: The tip of my horn is getting closer to you.

lines.zh: 我绕着花坛走，堵住你的路。
lines.en: I circle the flowerbed to cut off your path.

lines.zh: 你喜欢剪东西，我记住了。
lines.en: You like cutting things; I will remember that.

lines.zh: 我不叫了，我叫起来不好听。
lines.en: I have stopped mooing; it does not sound good anymore.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我随时会冲。
lines.en: Do not blink; I may charge at any moment.

lines.zh: 一角顶过去，花瓣跟着飞。
lines.en: I drive my horn in and petals fly with it.

lines.zh: 你被撞得后退，我又补一下。
lines.en: You stagger back and I hit again.

lines.zh: 这一下是替那片花田打的。
lines.en: This one is for that flower field.

lines.zh: 我的头很硬，你该知道。
lines.en: My head is hard; you should know that.

lines.zh: 撞上去时，我背上的花全散了。
lines.en: On impact every bloom on my back scatters.

lines.zh: 你手里的剪刀飞出去了。
lines.en: The shears flew out of your hand.

lines.zh: 我喘了一声，再来。
lines.en: I huff once and come again.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩在你脚边，这就是警告。
lines.en: My hoof lands by your foot; that is the warning.

lines.zh: 我撞得自己头也发晕。
lines.en: I hit so hard my own head spins.

lines.zh: 别倒下，我还没撞够。
lines.en: Do not fall yet; I am not done hitting.

lines.zh: 我从花丛里站起来，背上全是毛茛。
lines.en: I rise out of the flowers covered in buttercups.

lines.zh: 这片繁花森林，今天多了一头牛。
lines.en: The flower forest has one more cow today.

lines.zh: 我出生时，脚边开了一圈黄花。
lines.en: When I was born a ring of yellow opened at my feet.

lines.zh: 露水还在花上，我踩着湿草出来。
lines.en: Dew still on the blossoms, I step out through wet grass.

lines.zh: 蜜蜂先发现了我。
lines.en: The bees found me first.

lines.zh: 风把我的气味吹遍了这片林子。
lines.en: The wind carried my scent across the whole wood.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，世界是黄色和绿色的。
lines.en: I open my eyes on a world of yellow and green.

lines.zh: 有人在这附近种过花，我闻得出来。
lines.en: Someone planted flowers near here; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我的第一声哞叫，惊飞了树上的鸟。
lines.en: My first moo startles the birds out of the trees.

lines.zh: 花在我背上慢慢张开。
lines.en: The blooms open slowly across my back.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里走出来，颜色亮得刺眼。
lines.en: I walk out of the shade, bright enough to sting the eye.

lines.zh: 这地方花太多，我不知先吃哪朵。
lines.en: So many flowers here; I do not know which to eat first.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上花，烧出黄油味。
lines.en: Flame licks the blooms and they burn with a butter smell.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，花压得扁扁的。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my flowers are flattened.

lines.zh: 水淹过背，花全贴在皮上。
lines.en: Water closes over my back and the blooms plaster to my skin.

lines.zh: 气浪把花全吹光，我光秃秃站着。
lines.en: The blast strips every flower and I stand bare.

lines.zh: 箭穿过花瓣，扎进我的肩。
lines.en: An arrow passes through petals and sinks into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 药水一泼，我的花变成了紫色。
lines.en: Potion splashes me and my flowers turn purple.

lines.zh: 花田被人铲平，我饿得站不稳。
lines.en: Someone cleared the flower field and hunger makes me sway.

lines.zh: 雷落在花丛，我的角还嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the flowers and my horn still rings.

lines.zh: 我一直掉，花也跟着我掉。
lines.en: I keep falling and the flowers fall with me.
